scenes.say: Hi, I'm Saffi! Spirula Studio takes raw video all the way to Gaussian splats in one program. Today, how it handles a three sixty camera.

scenes.title: Rewritten, not wrapped
scenes.sub: What usually sits behind a launcher

scenes.title: What it rewrote instead of wrapping
scenes.say: Most all in one splat tools are a launcher around other people's programs. Here, each one was written again.

items.say: COLMAP became a structure from motion module on Vulkan, porting its algorithms and defaults, not its code.
PyTorch became a small inference runtime written in Slang.
The video decoders are its own, running on the graphics card.
And the segmentation model that masks out the operator runs as compute shaders.

scenes.title: One trainer, a GUI and a CLI

steps.say: This is the desktop app. The same trainer drives it and the command line, so a cloud box runs exactly what your laptop runs.

scenes.title: A sphere into views
scenes.sub: What each 360 camera becomes before SfM
scenes.say: Chapter two. A sphere into views.

scenes.title: Hand SfM the panorama, or cut it?

left.title: One panorama
left.say: The easy route hands structure from motion the stitched panorama. Both lenses become one camera, downsampled to four point four pixels per degree.

right.title: Views, one lens each
items: each view is a true pinhole
right.say: Spirula cuts views that each read one lens. A face holds sixteen point seven pixels per degree, and a rig ties the views of a frame together.

scenes.title: A GoPro frame, cut per lens

legend: The sphere unrolled. A MAX's two lenses meet at the dashes.
Front lens: its axis face, plus four half faces.
Back lens: the same five. No view crosses the seam.
MAX 2: six 100° faces on a corner. About 2% unseen.

steps.say: Here is the whole sphere, unrolled. A GoPro MAX does not stitch its two lenses. They meet down this dashed line, with real parallax across it.
So Spirula cuts per lens. The front lens gets the face on its axis, plus the near half of its four neighbours.
The back lens gets the same five. Every view reads one lens, so each is a true pinhole camera.
Only five point nine percent of the sphere is seen twice. The views of one frame share almost no features, so matches across time hold them together.
A MAX 2 is already stitched, so it gets six faces on a tilted cube. Kept level, my check finds about two percent of the sphere in no view.

scenes.title: Why a pinhole cannot hold a fisheye
scenes.text: pinhole r = f tan θ   fisheye r = f θ
scenes.say: Every camera model is a rule for where a ray lands.

parts.say: A pinhole puts a ray at the focal length times the tangent of its angle. At ninety degrees that is infinite.
An equidistant fisheye grows with the angle itself, so a lens of about two hundred degrees still fits on the sensor.

scenes.title: One dual-fisheye frame, start to finish

steps.say: A dual fisheye file is different again. It holds two fisheye tracks, one per lens.

steps.term: Thin prism fisheye: fisheye law plus eight terms
steps.say: Each track is already one central camera, so each gets a fisheye model of its own. No cutting.
Structure from motion is told the two lenses are a rig, back to back, and solves one pose for the whole frame.
Training renders the fisheye directly by default. It splits each lens into five faces only when you ask.

scenes.title: From splats to a building
scenes.sub: Metres, gravity, and which output to trust
scenes.say: Chapter three. From splats to a building.

scenes.title: Four ways to get metres
scenes.say: A building model needs metres and gravity. Spirula has four ways to get them.

items.say: The camera's own telemetry, read from the video file.
Printed markers, new in October and still marked experimental.
A distance you measured on site, between two points you pick in the editor.
Or a laser scan, which is metres by definition and already level.

steps.say: The mesh starts from the trained Gaussians.
Each one gives seven points: its centre, and two along each of its axes.

steps.term: Occupancy: inside unless some camera sees through
steps.say: Those points are joined into tetrahedra, and each corner is called inside only if every camera's line of sight to it is blocked.
The surface is cut where that occupancy crosses one half, then cleaned and textured.

scenes.title: What is not shown yet
scenes.say: Reading the code also showed what nobody has measured.

items.say: Nobody, the project included, has said how many millimetres off a wall the mesh lands.
The finished reconstructions are not yet scored against COLMAP on a public dataset.
And I read the code without running the binary.
